test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As per the Essential Defence Services Act, 2021 new plan, how many ordnance factories that make ammunition and other equipment for the armed forces will become part of the seven government-owned corporate entities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**41.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The Essential Defence Services Bill, 2021** was introduced in Lok Sabha by the Minister of Defence, Mr. Rajnath Singh, on July 22, 2021. 

 
 
• The Bill seeks to replace the Ordinance promulgated in June 2021. 
 
• The Bill allows the central government to prohibit strikes, lock-outs, and lay-offs in units engaged in essential defence services__.
